name: term-project-hw-09
description: Курсовий проєкт Marketplace API (NestJS): OpenAPI-контракт, zod-конфіг із fail-fast та ротація пароля БД без рестарту

scripts.migrate: bash scripts/with-secrets.sh dev npx typeorm -d dist/data-source.js migration:run
scripts.migrate:show: bash scripts/with-secrets.sh dev npx typeorm -d dist/data-source.js migration:show
scripts.migrate:revert: bash scripts/with-secrets.sh dev npx typeorm -d dist/data-source.js migration:revert
scripts.migration:generate: bash scripts/with-secrets.sh dev npx typeorm -d dist/data-source.js migration:generate
scripts.db:up: npm run secrets:init && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && cp secrets/db_password.example secrets/db_password && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec -T db psql -U marketplace -d marketplace
scripts.db:schema: docker compose exec -T db psql -U marketplace -d marketplace -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < db/schema.sql
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T db psql -U marketplace -d marketplace -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < db/seed.sql
scripts.db:indexes: docker compose exec -T db psql -U marketplace -d marketplace -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < db/indexes.sql && docker compose exec -T db psql -U marketplace -d marketplace -c "ANALYZE"
